India's men and women chess teams advance in Olympiad title race

In Round 7 of the Chess Olympiad, India's men's team defeated England 2.5-1.5, while the women's team beat Germany decisively, preserving India's chance to contest the gold medals. The men's side also faced Uzbekistan in a crucial tie for the title defence. Players Praggnanandhaa and Gukesh secured the win over England, and Savitha Shri scored a perfect 6‑point performance for the women.
